# Character asset provenance

The anatomical mesh, adult shape targets, rig joints and weights come from the official MakeHuman repository, retrieved 2026-10-11. Skin, eye, hair, footwear and everyday clothing assets come from its official CC0 system asset pack. Only asset data is included; MakeHuman program code is not included in the application.

- Core: https://github.com/makehumancommunity/makehuman/tree/master/makehuman/data
- License: https://github.com/makehumancommunity/makehuman/blob/master/LICENSE.ASSETS.md
- Pack catalogue: https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/makehuman_system_assets.html
- Download: https://files.makehumancommunity.org/asset_packs/makehuman_system_assets/makehuman_system_assets_cc0.zip
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal, copied as LICENSE.ASSETS.md. Embedded source headers identify Data Collection AB, Joel Palmius and Jonas Hauquier.

The original project clinical gown is preserved in ../../authored-garments.blend. The generator adapts the anatomy to metres, rebinds named game joints, fits the garments, and exports separate editable Blender scenes and compressed glTF files.

Source data is kept out of the public bundle. These characters are visual representations, not a validated anatomical model for image acquisition.
